jobs.title: AVP, Data Governance
jobs.description:
**Job Title**


AVP, Data Governance**Job Description**

**Role Overview**

  

Pacific Life Re is progressing a major business, technology and data transformation across Divisional Business Services. The Divisional Data Team is delivering the governed data foundations, warehouse, data governance \& quality, and reporting capabilities required to support Project Unify, regulatory and management reporting, operational resilience and future analytics including AI enablement.

  

The AVP, Head of Data Governance role provides strategic and delivery leadership for data governance and data quality across Pacific Life Re. The role translates the Data Strategy and Data Governance and Management Programme into practical standards, controls, operating practices and measurable outcomes, ensuring that data is trusted, understood, appropriately controlled and fit for operational, regulatory and strategic use.


Working with and across all business functions, Technology, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit and Pacific Life enterprise teams. The role embeds governance into our business\-as\-usual practices and project delivery, considering the wider information management lifecycle, including data management, handling, security, privacy, retention and ensures alignment with enterprise divisions. A central expectation is to communicate progress, risks, dependencies, decisions and business outcomes clearly to executive sponsors, governance forums, delivery teams and data users.

 **This role and is on\-site 4 days per week and work from home 1 day per week in Toronto, ON.**

 **Role Responsibilities**

 *Strategy, framework and accountability*

* Lead the execution of the divisional Data Governance strategy, framework, operating model and roadmap, aligned with the PL Re Data Strategy and relevant enterprise standards.
* Develop and maintain clear decision rights, accountability and escalation routes across Data Owners, Business Data Managers, Data Stewards, Business Process Owners and Technology Owners.
* Chair the Data Governance Forum and ensure that decisions, actions, standards, exceptions and escalations are recorded, communicated and progressed.
* Define and report measures for governance maturity, adoption, control effectiveness and the resolution of material data issues.

 *Programme delivery*

* Support the VP for Data, in delivering the Data Governance and Management Programme, including mobilisation, analysis, target\-state design, investment planning, prioritised remediation and transition into sustainable implementation.
* In collaboration with strategic projects and business workstreams, embed data requirements, definitions, ownership, quality thresholds, lineage, controls, acceptance criteria and governance sign\-off throughout delivery.
* Maintain an integrated delivery view of milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, resources, budgets, benefits and readiness, escalating decisions promptly and constructively.
* Provide executive sponsors and governance bodies with concise, evidence\-based updates on progress, outcomes, residual risks and decisions required.

 *Data Quality*

* Develop and implement the divisional data quality strategy and operating model, covering critical data, quality rules, measures, controls, scorecards, root\-cause analysis and remediation prioritisation.
* Lead the adoption of metadata, business glossary, lineage and data catalogue capabilities, ensuring that priority data assets are discoverable, consistently defined and supported by accountable business roles.
* In collaboration with Business Analysts, Data Engineering, Reporting and Architecture, embed governance by design into data products, semantic models, workspaces and reporting solutions.
* Direct the effective use and integration of strategic governance and data quality technologies, including Collibra and Informatica IDMC, with a focus on control outcomes and business adoption.

 *Risk, lifecycle \& assurance*

* Lead data lifecycle governance, including retention, classification, discoverability, permitted access, defensible disposition and remediation of identified control gaps.
* Act as the senior Data Governance contact for regulatory, audit and risk activity, coordinating evidence, management responses, remediation plans and reporting through the appropriate governance routes.
* In collaboration with Legal, Data Protection, Information Security, Risk and Technology, translate policy and regulatory requirements into proportionate, implementable data controls.
* Monitor material data risks and issues, challenge remediation plans and support accountable business and technology leaders in reaching documented decisions on residual risk. Working closely with legal and risk functions.

 *People, engagement and capability*

* Build and lead a high\-performing Data Governance team, setting clear objectives, developing capability, delegating effectively and creating succession depth.
* Develop and maintain an engagement and communication plan that translates governance priorities into clear executive narratives, adoption messages, training and role\-based guidance.
* Establish and support an active stewardship community that shares good practice, resolves cross\-functional issues and embeds governance in day\-to\-day business activity.
* Manage specialist partners and contractors against clear deliverables, quality expectations, knowledge\-transfer requirements and value outcomes.

 **Skills \& Experience**

* Extensive experience in data governance, data management, data quality and data leadership within a complex, regulated organisation.
* Demonstrable success in moving governance from policy and framework design into practical delivery, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong programme and change delivery experience, with the ability to coordinate concurrent workstreams, dependencies, risks, resources and budgets.
* Strong knowledge of data ownership and stewardship, metadata, business

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Architecture
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**


The Director of Enterprise Architecture is a strategic leadership role responsible for defining and advancing SE Health’s enterprise architecture vision. This position establishes architecture discipline as a cornerstone of SE Health’s modernization strategy by aligning technology capabilities with business priorities, enabling digital transformation, and ensuring successful integration of critical platforms such as the digital patient record, people/finance/payroll systems, contact center, service management, and others.  

The Director leads enterprise\-wide architecture decisions that drive agility, scalability, security, and measurable business outcomes. This includes building and maturing the Enterprise Architecture function, establishing an Architecture Review Board, and delivering a three\-year technology roadmap that incorporates strategic platforms, cloud strategy, data and analytics capabilities, integration architecture, and security and compliance posture. The Director ensures successful architecture and integration of platforms such as Alayacare and Workday, while driving adoption of best practices, standards, and governance across technology domains. By translating business objectives into coherent, secure, and sustainable technology designs, the Director plays a critical role in spearheading a digital transformation that enhances the experience of patients, families, employees, and clients, supporting SE Health’s mission of exceptional home and community care.

**Primary Accountabilities:**

**Enterprise Architecture Strategy and Governance**

* Develop and execute an enterprise architecture strategy and multi\-year roadmap that enables modernization, interoperability, and alignment with organizational goals, including maximizing value from core enterprise platforms (e.g., Alayacare, Workday).
* Establish and lead enterprise architecture governance processes (e.g., an Architecture Review Board or Enterprise Architecture Council) to define standards, manage technical debt, and inform major technology and investment decisions.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to the CDO, CIO, CTO, and senior leadership, translating business priorities into sustainable, secure, enterprise\-wide technology designs.
* Assess and improve enterprise architecture maturity, documenting improvements and outcomes aligned to business KPIs and informing continuous evolution of architecture practices.
* Drive mission\-critical enterprise architecture and data modernization projects, providing strategic oversight and ensuring integration, scalability, and compliance across platforms and business functions.

 **Technology, Cloud and Systems Integration Architecture**

* Lead the architecture, integration, and modernization of core enterprise platforms, including Alayacare, Workday, Procura, ERP, CRM, HRIS, Finance, and scheduling systems, to enable a cohesive and interoperable ecosystem across business and clinical operations.
* Define and oversee enterprise reference architectures, integration and data standards, patterns, and roadmaps that promote modernization, automation, analytics enablement, and business process optimization.
* Lead modernization efforts to rationalize applications, reduce technical debt, and migrate or retire legacy platforms using a cloud\-smart, scalable approach.
* Oversee enterprise solution architecture across cloud, hybrid, and on\-premises environments to ensure performance, resilience, security, and cost\-efficiency, including multi\-cloud strategy across AWS and Azure.
* Guide adoption of architectural best practices across security, operational excellence, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization domains.
* Review and evaluate solution designs and technology proposals, providing direction and recommendations through architecture governance forums.
* Analyze enterprise technology and data architecture requirements to support new applications, system scalability, and platform integrations.

 **Leadership, People and Continuous Improvement**

* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing enterprise architecture team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence.
* Drive continuous improvement and EA maturity by introducing modern frameworks, methodologies, and tooling (e.g., TOGAF, HOPEX) to enhance consistency, documentation, and solution quality.
* Embed security and privacy by design across architecture practices, ensuring adherence to cybersecurity, privacy, and healthcare compliance requirements.
* Build strong partnerships with Digital, Security, and Business leaders to influence technology strategy, support demand intake, and ensure alignment of solutions to business needs.
* Champion digital transformation and innovation by evaluating emerging technologies (e.g., mobile, IoT, telehealth, AI) and recommending their adoption where they advance SE Health’s mission and services.

 **Data and Analytics Architecture**

* Define enterprise data architecture strategies, standards, and models that enable analytics, AI, and data\-driven decision\-making across the organization.
* Partner with Data \& Analytics teams to design and evolve data platforms (e.g., data lake/warehouse) to support enterprise information management, governance, reporting, and advanced analytics.
* Provide leadership, guidance, and mentoring to data architecture and solution design teams on data and integration best practices.
* Collaborate with data science and analytics teams to support AI\-enabled insights, intelligent automation, and emerging technologies that drive value for clinical and business functions.

 **AI, Automation \& Intelligent Systems**

* Lead integration of AI\-driven insights and intelligent automation into enterprise applications and workflows.
* Partner with data science teams to enable machine learning, predictive analytics, and data\-driven optimization across clinical and business functions.

jobs.title: Vice President, Product Line Leader – Professional & Financial Risks
jobs.description:
Lead the strategy, performance and overall health of Markel Canada's Professional \& Financial Risks portfolio, including Errors \& Omissions, Directors \& Officers, Cyber, Technology and other specialist financial and professional lines. The role is accountable for profitable growth, portfolio mix and capital efficiency; underwriting appetite, standards and governance; pricing and portfolio performance; coverage intent and product strategy; material referrals and exceptions; emerging\-risk and claims\-trend oversight; talent and technical capability; and senior market leadership. PFR comprises several distinct specialist businesses. The PLL must have strong financial and professional lines expertise and sufficient technical breadth to understand, challenge and lead across the portfolio. Deep expertise in one or more  

  

PFR areas is an asset, but identical specialist depth across every product is not required. The PLL remains accountable for underwriting standards, coverage intent, guidelines and product direction, while increasingly leading detailed development and execution through product specialists, underwriters and internal or external resources. The role works closely with Field teams and functional partners to build technical and leadership depth and ensure decisions are made at the appropriate level.**What part will you play?**
----------------------------

  

If you’re looking for a place where you can make a meaningful difference, you’ve found it. The work we do at Markel gives people the confidence to move forward and seize opportunities, and you’ll find your fit among our global community of optimists and problem\-solvers. We’re always pushing each other to go further because we believe that when we realize our potential, we can help others reach theirs. Join us and play your part in something special!

**The opportunity:**
--------------------


We are seeking a senior underwriting leader to lead the strategy, performance and health of our Professional \& Financial Risks (PFR) portfolio in Canada. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of Markel Canada’s PFR portfolio, influence broader organizational strategy and strengthen our presence across specialty areas, customer segments and distribution channels. PFR brings together several distinct specialist businesses, including across our E\&O, D\&O and Cyber product lines. This role leads them collectively as one portfolio, while recognizing that each requires its own technical expertise, market knowledge and underwriting strategy. You will be accountable for sustainable profitable growth, portfolio mix, underwriting direction and the technical capability of the PFR business. As a senior leader, you will collaborate with other product line leaders, Field distribution teams, and other functional teams across global operations. Working closely with the Markel Canada leadership team, you will join a values\-driven culture with integrity and accountability at its core, with significant onward career opportunities.


If you are an underwriting leader who builds strong businesses and technical capability, brings sound judgment to a complex portfolio, and excels at creating value and market impact, this is your opportunity to make a difference.

  



This is an opportunity to join a growing and ambitious business in a high\-impact and visible role at a pivotal time in our journey. You will lead the development and delivery of Markel’s Professional \& Financial Risks (PFR) strategy in Canada, building greater growth, cohesion and performance across the PFR portfolio.


As part of the Product Leadership team, reporting into the SVP Underwriting, you are the senior leader responsible for the PFR underwriting strategy at Markel Canada. PFR brings together a range of specialist products, including Professional Indemnity/E\&O, Management Liability (D\&O, EPL, Fiduciary), Cyber, Crime, and Tech E\&O and Fintech packages. The role is accountable for the full PFR product line, written through our specialty teams, Sectors, Digital Portal and Delegated Underwriting. Markel intends to profitably grow the PFR portfolio, in coordination with other lines of business, by strengthening our presence in our areas of expertise and creating new avenues for growth.


The role works closely with Field underwriting teams and with Claims, Actuarial, Data and Analytics, Operations and Distribution, as well as the International OCUO (Office of the Chief Underwriting Officer) and other UK\-based colleagues and, occasionally, US\-based colleagues, connecting Canadian opportunities with Markel’s broader international capabilities.

**What you'll be doing:**
-------------------------

* Own the strategy, performance and health of the Professional \& Financial Risks (PFR) portfolio, delivering sustainable profitability and growth across its component businesses.
* Translate the goals established by the President \& Managing Director and SVP of Underwriting into a clear, prioritized PFR agenda, and communicate it across the business.
* Set portfolio mix and allocation across the PFR businesses, with clear accountability for underwriting appetite, pricing adequacy and portfolio economics, and direct portfolio remediation where needed.
* Champion the technical capability of PFR, working with Field leaders and people managers on development, coaching and succession for PFR talent, and supporting specialists and senior underwriters to take ownership so that technical decisions are made at the appropriate level.
* Set the direction for underwriting guidelines, sector\-specific underwriting frameworks, product and coverage development, underwriting authorities and training priorities, with detailed development led by the appropriate product and sector specialists, underwriters and Field teams.
* Manage technical wordings \& endorsements, product development, underwriting guidance and governance for the PFR portfolio, including oversight of underwriting

jobs.title: Director, Specialty Compliance and Ethics - Environmental Health & Safety (Retail Stores)
jobs.description:
**Résumé des fonctions...**
---------------------------

This role leads retail health and safety initiatives, monitors legal regulations, and develops strategies to address health and safety risks, protect associates and customers, and support safe operations.  

Ce que vous ferez...


The Director, Specialty Compliance and Ethics develops and implements health and safety strategies to ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations across Walmart Canada’s retail stores. This may include designing and maintaining national health and safety programs, conducting risk assessments, and partnering with Retail Operations and other stakeholders to identify and mitigate risks. The role involves staying abreast of industry trends and regulatory changes to adapt health and safety strategies accordingly.

  

The Director builds and leads a team responsible for monitoring health and safety performance and managing key risk areas, including injury prevention, ergonomics, equipment, and fire and life safety. This includes developing training programs and awareness campaigns to foster a culture of health and safety throughout the organization. The position also ensures that health and safety activities are aligned with global standards and best practices.

  

In addition to internal responsibilities, the Director cultivates external relationships with regulators and industry partners to strengthen the company’s health and safety reputation. This involves articulating corporate positions on health and safety matters, responding to regulatory inquiries and enforcement matters, and leading regulatory outreach meetings.

  

Overall, the Director focuses on continuous improvement of health and safety processes and integrating safety metrics into core business practices. This includes evaluating program effectiveness, using data and AI tools with high degree of competency and appropriate human oversight, ensuring resource alignment with company strategy, and leveraging global talent and resources to achieve business goals.

  

  

**Qualifications**

  

* University or college degree in Occupational Health \& Safety, Environmental Health, Engineering, Science, Business or a related discipline.
* Canadian Registered Safety Professional (CRSP) or equivalent recognized Health \& Safety professional designation.
* Significant Health \& Safety leadership experience in retail, logistics, distribution or another large, geographically dispersed operating environment.
* Experience supporting business growth, new locations, major operational change or transformation.
* Experience with environmental compliance, fire and life safety, ergonomics, equipment or facility safety.
* Experience developing data\-driven H\&S management systems, dashboards, leading indicators and risk\-based monitoring programs.
* Bilingual English/French capability is an asset.

Respect the Individual:
  

  

Builds high\-performing teams; seeks, and embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas and experiences; creates a workplace and experiences where all associates feel seen, supported and connected through culture of belonging so associates thrive and perform; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all.
  

  

Creates a discipline and focus around developing talent through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; builds the talent pipeline, fosters an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work, empowers associates and partners to act in the best interest of the customer and company, and regularly recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments; supports strategies and drives initiatives that attract and retain the best talent.
  

  

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively and cross\-functionally to achieve objectives; and communicates and listens attentively, with energy and positivity to motivate, influence, and inspire commitment and action.
  

  

  

Acts with Integrity:
  

  

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by taking action to advance opportunity, sustainability, community, and integrity (e.g., creating fair opportunities for associates and suppliers, driving local giving efforts).
  

  

Ensures that teams follow the law, our code of conduct and company policies; promotes an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns, and models our culture of non\-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates and takes action, and enables others to do the same; holds self and teams accountable for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.
  

  

Acts as an altruistic servant leader and is consistently humble, self\-aware.
  

  

Serve our Customers:
  

  

Delivers expected business results while putting the customer first and consistently applying an omni\-merchant mindset and acting with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.
  

  

Adopts a holistic perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans and implementing strategies.
  

  

Strive for Excellence:
  

  

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions, and fosters an environment that supports learning, innovation, learning from mistakes, and intelligent risk\-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.
  

  

Drives continuous improvements, supervises the adoption of new technology, and supports digital disruption in line with Walmart’s business model.

Are you a highly organized, proactive professional who enjoys supporting senior leaders? We are looking for an Administrative Assistant to be a trusted partner to two Senior Directors in Merchandising and their teams across the Store Support Centre (SSC) and the Innovation Centre. You will take ownership, anticipate needs, and handle confidential information with discretion so both leaders can focus on their highest priorities.


Position Overview


You will serve as the primary point of contact and coordinator for both teams (SSC and IC), managing competing priorities across two leaders and partnering with Merchandising, MET, HR, Finance, Facilities, and vendor partners to support business operations.


Key Responsibilities


Executive Support

* Manage two complex calendars, prioritizing requests, resolving conflicts, and protecting time for key priorities.
* Understand each leader's priorities, working style, and preferences, and tailor support accordingly.


Multi\-Site Coordination (SSC and Innovation Centre)

* Coordinate logistics across both locations, including meeting rooms, hybrid meeting technology, and visitor access.
* Act as the on\-site contact when leaders are working from the other location to maintain continuity of business activity.


Office Operations and Administration

* Coordinate travel, process expense reports, and support purchase orders, invoices, and vendor payments in line with company policies.
* Manage office administration, including supplies, equipment, access requests, and workspace logistics across both sites.


Team Support, Events, and Special Projects

* Coordinate onboarding for new team members, including Day 1 readiness, equipment, system access, and site orientation.
* Support special projects and ad hoc reporting as assigned.


Success Measures

* Both leaders’ calendars and meetings are well managed, with time aligned to their highest priorities and action items tracked through completion.
* Internal teams, business partners, and vendors experience both offices as responsive, organized, and professional, with consistent coordination across the SSC and the Innovation Centre.
* Travel, expenses, purchase orders, and invoices are processed accurately and on time.
* Administrative processes show measurable improvements in efficiency and consistency.


Qualifications

* Diploma or degree in Business Administration, Office Administration, or a related field preferred.
* 3\+ years of administrative or executive assistant experience, ideally supporting more than one senior leader across multiple locations or teams.
* Advanced Microsoft 365 skills (Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, Excel, SharePoint); Workday experience is an asset.
* Retail or merchandising experience is an asset.


Core Competencies and Skills

* Integrity, sound judgment, and discretion when handling confidential and sensitive information.
* Strong organization, prioritization, and attention to detail across two leaders and competing deadlines.
* Clear, professional communication and relationship building with senior leaders, associates, and external partners.
* Proactive, service\-first mindset; adaptable and able to anticipate needs and work independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Curiosity about AI and automation tools to simplify work.


Scope and Working Conditions

* Individual contributor role supporting two Senior Directors, Merchandising, and their leadership teams.
* On\-site role, in office five days per week across the SSC and the Innovation Centre, with regular local travel between sites as business needs require.
* Physical requirements: No specific requirements beyond those associated with a professional office environment.

jobs.title: Director, Integrated Planning & Procurement
jobs.description:
**Reporting to**


President \& COO

**Direct Reports**


4 direct reports; approximately 8 team members in total

**Purpose**


The Director, Integrated Planning \& Procurement is accountable for translating commercial demand into reliable material, procurement, production and inventory plans. This leader owns Select Foods’ end\-to\-end planning operating system, including demand planning, materials planning, procurement, production planning, inventory control, S\&OP and the business ownership of SAGE MRP.


This is a hands\-on executive leadership role in a lean, growing organization. The successful candidate must be equally comfortable developing long\-term supply\-chain strategy, leading an Executive S\&OP discussion, coaching managers and personally working through an MRP implementation, supplier shortage, inventory imbalance or production\-planning issue when required.

**Responsibilities**

* **Own and Lead S\&OP**: Own, chair and continuously improve the monthly S\&OP cycle: Demand Review, Supply and Capacity Review, Procurement and Materials Review, Integrated Reconciliation and Executive S\&OP.
* Establish one credible production plan, document assumptions and risks, and ensure unresolved service, capacity, inventory, cost and supply decisions are escalated to the Enterprise Leadership Team.
* Connect volume plans to financial commitments, working\-capital expectations and operating priorities.
* Maintain clear meeting charters, calendars, inputs, decision rights, actions and follow\-up disciplines.
* **Demand Planning:** Establish a disciplined demand planning process in partnership with Sales and Finance.
* Create and maintain the unconstrained demand plan, incorporating baseline demand, customer intelligence, promotions, new business, losses and one\-time events.
* Monitor forecast accuracy and bias at useful product and customer levels; lead root\-cause actions where performance falls outside agreed tolerances.
* Challenge assumptions constructively and ensure demand changes are translated into supply, materials, capacity and inventory implications.
* **Materials Planning and SAGE MRP:** Act as the business owner of SAGE MRP and ensure it produces trusted, actionable recommendations.
* Own planning policies and parameters, including lead times, safety stocks, order quantities, minimums, planning horizons, yields, scrap factors and make/buy settings.
* Ensure BOM, master data, supplier and inventory data are sufficiently accurate to support reliable planning.
* Lead root\-cause correction to shortages rather than relying on manual workarounds.
* Develop team capability and standard work for running, interpreting and maintaining MRP.
* **Production and Capacity Planning:** Convert the agreed demand plan into feasible medium\-term capacity plans and executable production schedules.
* Balance service, labour, equipment capacity, changeovers, material availability, shelf life, cost and inventory.
* Establish planning time horizons, schedule change rules and a clear handoff from planning to operations.
* Lead recovery plans when demand, supply or capacity deviates from plan.
* **Procurement and Supplier Performance:** Lead procurement strategy and execution for raw materials, packaging and other assigned categories.
* Improve material availability, supplier reliability, lead times, commercial terms and supply resilience.
* Implement supplier scorecards, regular performance reviews, risk mitigation and structured escalation.
* Ensure purchasing decisions reflect total cost, minimum order quantities, working capital, service risk and quality requirements.
* **Inventory Strategy and Control:** Develop differentiated inventory strategies for make\-to\-stock and make\-to\-order products, raw materials, WIP and finished goods.
* Segment items using demand variability, lead time, service expectations, shelf life, margin, MOQ, production frequency and supply risk.
* Establish safety\-stock, reorder, lot\-sizing and coverage policies with clear ownership and review frequency.
* Lead initiatives to reduce excess, obsolete and slow\-moving inventory while protecting customer service and production continuity.
* Manage overage, obsolete materials cost effectively including charge backs to customer as appropriate.
* Partner with Finance and Operations to improve inventory accuracy, governance and working\-capital performance.
* **Warehouse Operations and Carrier Management:** Oversee warehouse operations ensuring safe, efficient and compliant practices.
* Align warehouse capacity, labour and processes with the production plan, customer service requirements and inventory policies.
* Monitor warehouse and carrier performance through clear KPIs, regular reviews and corrective actions.
* Lead carrier strategy and negotiate carrier contracts, rates and service terms to balance cost, reliability and customer commitments.
* **People and Functional Leadership:** Lead four direct reports and an overall team of approximately 8 across planning, procurement, warehouse and inventory control.
* Set clear accountabilities, decision rights, standard work and performance expectations.
* Coach managers and planners to solve problems independently while remaining close enough to the work to identify weak processes, data or controls.
* Build succession, cross\-training and technical capability across demand planning, supply planning, MRP, procurement and inventory.
* **Strategy and Continuous Improvement:** Develop and execute a multi\-year roadmap for planning maturity, inventory, sourcing, capacity, systems and team capability.
* Lead practical improvement initiatives that deliver measurable benefits in service, schedule adherence, inventory, supplier performance, cost and productivity.
* Contribute to enterprise decisions bringing an integrated commercial, operational and financial perspective.
* Translate strategy into clear priorities, owners, milestones and sustained operating routines.
**Qualifications**

**Description:**

  


**About us:**  

  

The Lawrence Bloomberg Faculty of Nursing at the University of Toronto is a globally recognized leader in nursing education, research, and practice. Our mission is to advance health through a commitment to excellence in education and research. We are dedicated to creating a supportive environment that fosters innovation and collaboration among our faculty, staff, and students.  

  

**Your opportunity:**  

  

Reporting to the Assistant Dean, Registrarial and Student Services, the Associate Director of Recruitment and Admissions is responsible for strategy and implementation of the recruitment and admissions processes and development of marketing and communications materials for all undergraduate (BScN) and graduate (MN, PMNP, PhD and DN) programs at the Lawrence Bloomberg Faculty of Nursing.  

  

In consultation with faculty committees, the incumbent will assume a leadership role in setting a vision at the Faculty, including: (1\) ensuring the effective implementation of strategies and initiatives to recruit and admit well\-qualified students to the Faculty of Nursing; and (2\) overseeing the review of admissions applications by the Admissions \& Academic Administrator to ensure the process is performed with consistency as well as with equity, diversity, inclusion, and access principles in mind.  

  

**Your responsibilities will include:**

  


* Building and strengthening relationships with stakeholders and partners of strategic importance
* Conducting detailed data analysis to inform recruitment strategies and plans
* Promoting programs at recruitment events
* Preparing complex statistical information for inclusion in recruitment plans
* Planning and implementing the evaluations of recruitment programs to support strategic planning activities
* Leading the development and making recommendations for program admission and enrolment policies
* Coordinating admission processes with departmental/divisional contacts.

  


**Essential Qualifications:**

  


* Bachelor's Degree or acceptable combination of equivalent experience.
* Six to seven years progressive experience in recruitment and admissions including outreach work with under\-represented groups.
* Experience developing, implementing, and evaluating recruitment programs.
* Demonstrated experience drafting and delivering recruitment presentations to large and diverse audiences.
* Demonstrated experience managing admissions processes, including overseeing, reviewing and assessing applications, and working closely with admissions committees.
* Experience advising prospective applicants, parents, and guidance counsellors on academic programs and admission requirements.
* Experience establishing, managing, and strengthening relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders including strategic partners.
* Experience developing and implementing communication plans that support recruitment and enrolment strategies.
* Experience conducting detailed data analysis to inform recruitment and admissions strategies.
* Experience identifying and implementing process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and productivity.
* Demonstrated leadership skills; Proven ability to supervise staff.
* Exceptional computer skills including demonstrated experience with Microsoft Office including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Access and working knowledge of Keynote, Prezi, and HTML.
* Experience managing admissions processes using Slate or a similar CRM/admissions platform, including providing user support and troubleshooting technical issues.
* Strong conflict resolution, problem\-solving, judgment, and decision\-making skills, with the ability to exercise tact and discretion.
* Strong ability to multitask and manage multiple, competing priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  


**Assets (Nonessential):**

  


* Familiarity with the professional healthcare landscape.

  

  

**To be successful in this role you will be:**

  


* Approachable
* Communicator
* Efficient
* Multi\-tasker
* Organized
* Self\-directed
* Tactful

**Job Title**


AVP, Data Governance**Job Description**

**Role Overview**

  

Pacific Life Re is progressing a major business, technology and data transformation across Divisional Business Services. The Divisional Data Team is delivering the governed data foundations, warehouse, data governance \& quality, and reporting capabilities required to support Project Unify, regulatory and management reporting, operational resilience and future analytics including AI enablement.

  

The AVP, Head of Data Governance role provides strategic and delivery leadership for data governance and data quality across Pacific Life Re. The role translates the Data Strategy and Data Governance and Management Programme into practical standards, controls, operating practices and measurable outcomes, ensuring that data is trusted, understood, appropriately controlled and fit for operational, regulatory and strategic use.


Working with and across all business functions, Technology, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit and Pacific Life enterprise teams. The role embeds governance into our business\-as\-usual practices and project delivery, considering the wider information management lifecycle, including data management, handling, security, privacy, retention and ensures alignment with enterprise divisions. A central expectation is to communicate progress, risks, dependencies, decisions and business outcomes clearly to executive sponsors, governance forums, delivery teams and data users.

 **This role and is on\-site 4 days per week and work from home 1 day per week in Toronto, ON.**

 **Role Responsibilities**

 *Strategy, framework and accountability*

* Lead the execution of the divisional Data Governance strategy, framework, operating model and roadmap, aligned with the PL Re Data Strategy and relevant enterprise standards.
* Develop and maintain clear decision rights, accountability and escalation routes across Data Owners, Business Data Managers, Data Stewards, Business Process Owners and Technology Owners.
* Chair the Data Governance Forum and ensure that decisions, actions, standards, exceptions and escalations are recorded, communicated and progressed.
* Define and report measures for governance maturity, adoption, control effectiveness and the resolution of material data issues.

 *Programme delivery*

* Support the VP for Data, in delivering the Data Governance and Management Programme, including mobilisation, analysis, target\-state design, investment planning, prioritised remediation and transition into sustainable implementation.
* In collaboration with strategic projects and business workstreams, embed data requirements, definitions, ownership, quality thresholds, lineage, controls, acceptance criteria and governance sign\-off throughout delivery.
* Maintain an integrated delivery view of milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, resources, budgets, benefits and readiness, escalating decisions promptly and constructively.
* Provide executive sponsors and governance bodies with concise, evidence\-based updates on progress, outcomes, residual risks and decisions required.

 *Data Quality*

* Develop and implement the divisional data quality strategy and operating model, covering critical data, quality rules, measures, controls, scorecards, root\-cause analysis and remediation prioritisation.
* Lead the adoption of metadata, business glossary, lineage and data catalogue capabilities, ensuring that priority data assets are discoverable, consistently defined and supported by accountable business roles.
* In collaboration with Business Analysts, Data Engineering, Reporting and Architecture, embed governance by design into data products, semantic models, workspaces and reporting solutions.
* Direct the effective use and integration of strategic governance and data quality technologies, including Collibra and Informatica IDMC, with a focus on control outcomes and business adoption.

 *Risk, lifecycle \& assurance*

* Lead data lifecycle governance, including retention, classification, discoverability, permitted access, defensible disposition and remediation of identified control gaps.
* Act as the senior Data Governance contact for regulatory, audit and risk activity, coordinating evidence, management responses, remediation plans and reporting through the appropriate governance routes.
* In collaboration with Legal, Data Protection, Information Security, Risk and Technology, translate policy and regulatory requirements into proportionate, implementable data controls.
* Monitor material data risks and issues, challenge remediation plans and support accountable business and technology leaders in reaching documented decisions on residual risk. Working closely with legal and risk functions.

 *People, engagement and capability*

* Build and lead a high\-performing Data Governance team, setting clear objectives, developing capability, delegating effectively and creating succession depth.
* Develop and maintain an engagement and communication plan that translates governance priorities into clear executive narratives, adoption messages, training and role\-based guidance.
* Establish and support an active stewardship community that shares good practice, resolves cross\-functional issues and embeds governance in day\-to\-day business activity.
* Manage specialist partners and contractors against clear deliverables, quality expectations, knowledge\-transfer requirements and value outcomes.

 **Skills \& Experience**

* Extensive experience in data governance, data management, data quality and data leadership within a complex, regulated organisation.
* Demonstrable success in moving governance from policy and framework design into practical delivery, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong programme and change delivery experience, with the ability to coordinate concurrent workstreams, dependencies, risks, resources and budgets.
* Strong knowledge of data ownership and stewardship, metadata, business

new_jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Architecture
new_jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**


The Director of Enterprise Architecture is a strategic leadership role responsible for defining and advancing SE Health’s enterprise architecture vision. This position establishes architecture discipline as a cornerstone of SE Health’s modernization strategy by aligning technology capabilities with business priorities, enabling digital transformation, and ensuring successful integration of critical platforms such as the digital patient record, people/finance/payroll systems, contact center, service management, and others.  

The Director leads enterprise\-wide architecture decisions that drive agility, scalability, security, and measurable business outcomes. This includes building and maturing the Enterprise Architecture function, establishing an Architecture Review Board, and delivering a three\-year technology roadmap that incorporates strategic platforms, cloud strategy, data and analytics capabilities, integration architecture, and security and compliance posture. The Director ensures successful architecture and integration of platforms such as Alayacare and Workday, while driving adoption of best practices, standards, and governance across technology domains. By translating business objectives into coherent, secure, and sustainable technology designs, the Director plays a critical role in spearheading a digital transformation that enhances the experience of patients, families, employees, and clients, supporting SE Health’s mission of exceptional home and community care.

**Primary Accountabilities:**

**Enterprise Architecture Strategy and Governance**

* Develop and execute an enterprise architecture strategy and multi\-year roadmap that enables modernization, interoperability, and alignment with organizational goals, including maximizing value from core enterprise platforms (e.g., Alayacare, Workday).
* Establish and lead enterprise architecture governance processes (e.g., an Architecture Review Board or Enterprise Architecture Council) to define standards, manage technical debt, and inform major technology and investment decisions.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to the CDO, CIO, CTO, and senior leadership, translating business priorities into sustainable, secure, enterprise\-wide technology designs.
* Assess and improve enterprise architecture maturity, documenting improvements and outcomes aligned to business KPIs and informing continuous evolution of architecture practices.
* Drive mission\-critical enterprise architecture and data modernization projects, providing strategic oversight and ensuring integration, scalability, and compliance across platforms and business functions.

 **Technology, Cloud and Systems Integration Architecture**

* Lead the architecture, integration, and modernization of core enterprise platforms, including Alayacare, Workday, Procura, ERP, CRM, HRIS, Finance, and scheduling systems, to enable a cohesive and interoperable ecosystem across business and clinical operations.
* Define and oversee enterprise reference architectures, integration and data standards, patterns, and roadmaps that promote modernization, automation, analytics enablement, and business process optimization.
* Lead modernization efforts to rationalize applications, reduce technical debt, and migrate or retire legacy platforms using a cloud\-smart, scalable approach.
* Oversee enterprise solution architecture across cloud, hybrid, and on\-premises environments to ensure performance, resilience, security, and cost\-efficiency, including multi\-cloud strategy across AWS and Azure.
* Guide adoption of architectural best practices across security, operational excellence, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization domains.
* Review and evaluate solution designs and technology proposals, providing direction and recommendations through architecture governance forums.
* Analyze enterprise technology and data architecture requirements to support new applications, system scalability, and platform integrations.

 **Leadership, People and Continuous Improvement**

* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing enterprise architecture team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence.
* Drive continuous improvement and EA maturity by introducing modern frameworks, methodologies, and tooling (e.g., TOGAF, HOPEX) to enhance consistency, documentation, and solution quality.
* Embed security and privacy by design across architecture practices, ensuring adherence to cybersecurity, privacy, and healthcare compliance requirements.
* Build strong partnerships with Digital, Security, and Business leaders to influence technology strategy, support demand intake, and ensure alignment of solutions to business needs.
* Champion digital transformation and innovation by evaluating emerging technologies (e.g., mobile, IoT, telehealth, AI) and recommending their adoption where they advance SE Health’s mission and services.

 **Data and Analytics Architecture**

* Define enterprise data architecture strategies, standards, and models that enable analytics, AI, and data\-driven decision\-making across the organization.
* Partner with Data \& Analytics teams to design and evolve data platforms (e.g., data lake/warehouse) to support enterprise information management, governance, reporting, and advanced analytics.
* Provide leadership, guidance, and mentoring to data architecture and solution design teams on data and integration best practices.
* Collaborate with data science and analytics teams to support AI\-enabled insights, intelligent automation, and emerging technologies that drive value for clinical and business functions.

 **AI, Automation \& Intelligent Systems**

* Lead integration of AI\-driven insights and intelligent automation into enterprise applications and workflows.
* Partner with data science teams to enable machine learning, predictive analytics, and data\-driven optimization across clinical and business functions.

new_jobs.title: Vice President, Product Line Leader – Professional & Financial Risks
new_jobs.description:
Lead the strategy, performance and overall health of Markel Canada's Professional \& Financial Risks portfolio, including Errors \& Omissions, Directors \& Officers, Cyber, Technology and other specialist financial and professional lines. The role is accountable for profitable growth, portfolio mix and capital efficiency; underwriting appetite, standards and governance; pricing and portfolio performance; coverage intent and product strategy; material referrals and exceptions; emerging\-risk and claims\-trend oversight; talent and technical capability; and senior market leadership. PFR comprises several distinct specialist businesses. The PLL must have strong financial and professional lines expertise and sufficient technical breadth to understand, challenge and lead across the portfolio. Deep expertise in one or more  

  

PFR areas is an asset, but identical specialist depth across every product is not required. The PLL remains accountable for underwriting standards, coverage intent, guidelines and product direction, while increasingly leading detailed development and execution through product specialists, underwriters and internal or external resources. The role works closely with Field teams and functional partners to build technical and leadership depth and ensure decisions are made at the appropriate level.**What part will you play?**
----------------------------

  

If you’re looking for a place where you can make a meaningful difference, you’ve found it. The work we do at Markel gives people the confidence to move forward and seize opportunities, and you’ll find your fit among our global community of optimists and problem\-solvers. We’re always pushing each other to go further because we believe that when we realize our potential, we can help others reach theirs. Join us and play your part in something special!

**The opportunity:**
--------------------


We are seeking a senior underwriting leader to lead the strategy, performance and health of our Professional \& Financial Risks (PFR) portfolio in Canada. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of Markel Canada’s PFR portfolio, influence broader organizational strategy and strengthen our presence across specialty areas, customer segments and distribution channels. PFR brings together several distinct specialist businesses, including across our E\&O, D\&O and Cyber product lines. This role leads them collectively as one portfolio, while recognizing that each requires its own technical expertise, market knowledge and underwriting strategy. You will be accountable for sustainable profitable growth, portfolio mix, underwriting direction and the technical capability of the PFR business. As a senior leader, you will collaborate with other product line leaders, Field distribution teams, and other functional teams across global operations. Working closely with the Markel Canada leadership team, you will join a values\-driven culture with integrity and accountability at its core, with significant onward career opportunities.


If you are an underwriting leader who builds strong businesses and technical capability, brings sound judgment to a complex portfolio, and excels at creating value and market impact, this is your opportunity to make a difference.

  



This is an opportunity to join a growing and ambitious business in a high\-impact and visible role at a pivotal time in our journey. You will lead the development and delivery of Markel’s Professional \& Financial Risks (PFR) strategy in Canada, building greater growth, cohesion and performance across the PFR portfolio.


As part of the Product Leadership team, reporting into the SVP Underwriting, you are the senior leader responsible for the PFR underwriting strategy at Markel Canada. PFR brings together a range of specialist products, including Professional Indemnity/E\&O, Management Liability (D\&O, EPL, Fiduciary), Cyber, Crime, and Tech E\&O and Fintech packages. The role is accountable for the full PFR product line, written through our specialty teams, Sectors, Digital Portal and Delegated Underwriting. Markel intends to profitably grow the PFR portfolio, in coordination with other lines of business, by strengthening our presence in our areas of expertise and creating new avenues for growth.


The role works closely with Field underwriting teams and with Claims, Actuarial, Data and Analytics, Operations and Distribution, as well as the International OCUO (Office of the Chief Underwriting Officer) and other UK\-based colleagues and, occasionally, US\-based colleagues, connecting Canadian opportunities with Markel’s broader international capabilities.

**What you'll be doing:**
-------------------------

* Own the strategy, performance and health of the Professional \& Financial Risks (PFR) portfolio, delivering sustainable profitability and growth across its component businesses.
* Translate the goals established by the President \& Managing Director and SVP of Underwriting into a clear, prioritized PFR agenda, and communicate it across the business.
* Set portfolio mix and allocation across the PFR businesses, with clear accountability for underwriting appetite, pricing adequacy and portfolio economics, and direct portfolio remediation where needed.
* Champion the technical capability of PFR, working with Field leaders and people managers on development, coaching and succession for PFR talent, and supporting specialists and senior underwriters to take ownership so that technical decisions are made at the appropriate level.
* Set the direction for underwriting guidelines, sector\-specific underwriting frameworks, product and coverage development, underwriting authorities and training priorities, with detailed development led by the appropriate product and sector specialists, underwriters and Field teams.
* Manage technical wordings \& endorsements, product development, underwriting guidance and governance for the PFR portfolio, including oversight of underwriting

We’re building a relationship\-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.


At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.


To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com


**Summary** :


We are seeking a leader that can balance vision with execution to a newly formed enterprise MLOps team. The Director, Enterprise Machine Learning Frameworks \& Operations will lead the design, development, and scaling of our enterprise\-wide machine learning operations (MLOps) capability. This role is critical to establishing AI at scale, driving efficiency, reliability, and compliance across the model development lifecycle—from experimentation to production.
  

  

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong stakeholder engagement and can execute on a strategic vision. You will contribute to the MLOps strategy, enforce strict adherence to enterprise governance, and lead the implementation of tooling and frameworks to enable secure, scalable, and repeatable AI/ML delivery across the bank. Success will be built on defining the technical activities to mature and standardize the capability and in driving a measurable impact to build influence with stakeholders.

  

**What you’ll be doing**

The Director, Enterprise Machine Learning Frameworks \& Operations will lead the design, development, and scaling of enterprise\-wide ML Operations (MLOps / LLMOps) capabilities. This role is pivotal in establishing AI at scale by driving operational efficiency, reliability, and compliance throughout the entire model development lifecycle (from experimentation to production deployment). You will shape the MLOps strategy and oversee the implementation of tooling, frameworks, and engineering standards that ensure secure, scalable, and repeatable delivery of AI/ML and LLM solutions across the bank. You will architect and build reusable platform capabilities, reference architectures, deployment patterns, and platform services that support both traditional machine learning and large language model use cases across multiple lines of business. Success will be measured by your ability to define and standardize technical activities, mature operational practices, and drive measurable business impact and stakeholder adoption. The ideal candidate possesses deep technical expertise in MLOps, hands\-on engineering leadership, and strong stakeholder engagement skills to deliver on a strategic vision for enterprise\-scale AI operations.

  

*At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You’ll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you’ll spend 1–3 days per week on\-site, while other days will be remote.*

**How you’ll succeed**

* **Technical Leadership and Contribution \-** Translate strategic capability roadmaps into actionable technical deliverables, including the design and implementation of CI/CD pipelines, end\-to\-end MLOps workflows, and automated ML pipelines for data ingestion, training, validation, and deployment. Ensure workflows are compliant with regulatory and enterprise governance requirements, including approval gates, automated monitoring and alerts, and audit\-ready processes. Oversee the development of enterprise\-grade, production\-ready, and standardized MLOps capabilities to support scalable and reliable AI delivery across the organization. Set and communicate best practices and guidelines to ensure consistency and high\-quality delivery. Drive the creation of reusable frameworks, platform services, engineering standards, and deployment patterns that accelerate AI delivery while reducing operational complexity and duplication across teams.
* **Stakeholder Management and Collaboration \-** Build strong relationships and collaborate with business partners, technology teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders to gather requirements, prioritize initiatives, and align MLOps solutions with business objectives. Partner with AI governance, Compliance, and technology teams to ensure all solutions adhere to regulatory and internal standards. Participate in code reviews, identify updates to and the need for new documentation, and share best practices. Stay current with emerging AI/ML tools and techniques, actively contributing to a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement. Advise on the MLOps strategy and capability roadmap based on stakeholder feedback and emerging needs. Act as the primary point of contact for business and technical stakeholders regarding MLOps delivery.
* **MLOps/ LLMOps Development and Production Deployments–** Lead the end to end model deployment pipeline management. Develop and sustain production\-ready deployments (including support for APIs and open\-source models). Oversee Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines. Partner with AI and Enterprise technology teams to ensure alignment on reusable technology components across all use cases, incorporating compliance requirements early to avoid delays, and maintaining lineage and version tracking. Assess models to prevent performance degradation and establishing monitoring frameworks to analyze inference latency, optimize token usage, and detect potential hallucinations in real time

Exhibit strong influencing, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills, with the ability to align diverse stakeholders around common goals.
